data.rationale: The proposal follows the same procedure in the same order (Flights tab, trip type, origin and destination, dates, passengers, Search, Fastest, See flight, Select, Next) and has the right parameters, but it adds optional extras (round trip, direct-only) and the passenger step is vague, so a browser automation could mostly be built from it.
